rationale: Raised control authority and steady-state adaptation for ~2x heat loss: u_max 0.80->1.0, integral range [-0.25,0.25]->[-0.30,0.65], ki 0.012->0.022, kp 1.0->1.2, integration gate 0.12->0.20. Same nominal feedforward curve and safety cut, same filter structure. This lets the integrator learn the new ~0.9 hold for y=0.5 without windup on the nominal plant.

extra.machine_card: First-order heater y in [0,1], ambient ~0.08-0.09, delay ~6s. Pre: ss(y)=amb+~0.92*u, tau ~130-170s, hold(0.5)~0.38. Post: ss(y)=amb+~0.44*u, tau ~80-100s, hold(0.5)~0.90. K ratio ~0.8, L ratio ~1.7-2.0. Reachable with u=1.0 (ss ~0.52). No extra delay, no sensor change.
extra.predicted_behavior: Nominal: cold start with u~0.9 then backoff, enter 0.475-0.525 by ~180-220s, MAE ~0.006, in-band ~1.0, u_ss~0.39, no hard violations. Changed: cold start at ~0.9-1.0, rise with tau ~90s to 0.5 by ~250-300s, then hold with u~0.85-0.95, MAE post-settling <0.02, in-band >0.8. If plant were nominal the extra integrator stays near 0 and behavior matches old controller.
extra.diagnosis: Outflow/loss increased ~1.7-2.1x, actuator essentially unchanged. E9 u=0 decay fractional: 0.368->0.185 in 100s (excess ratio 0.34) vs E3 0.540->0.346 in 100s (ratio 0.58) = faster normalized decay, same ambient ~0.09 and same quantization. E10 initial slope at ambient (loss~0): 0.043/30s=0.00143/s vs E1 0.054/30s=0.00179/s ratio ~0.80, i.e. K_new/K_old~0.8. Steady delta ratio: post (0.309-0.09)=0.219 vs pre (0.54-0.08)=0.46 ratio ~0.48. Since ss=K/L, L_new/L_old=(0.8)/0.48~1.67 (2.1 if K unchanged). E11 early flattening tau ~80-100s vs pre ~150s confirms 0.6x tau = higher L. No delay increase (prompt fall in E9, prompt rise in E10 ~6s) and no sensor shift (same 0.09 ambient, same 0.005 steps). New hold for 0.5 is ~0.9-1.0: u=0.5 holds only 0.31, u=1.0 still rising at 0.44 after 80s with slope 0.002/s.
